facts.text: Brother, taste this. It came out of my lab. Do not tell Mother how I made it.
facts.why: Shuri never says this. The quote page lists her real lines and none of them is about tasting something from her lab. It is set in quote marks as her words.
facts.fix: I invite you to my lab and you just kick things around?!
